answer: Give each operator one blind-signed uniqueness credential, then let each agent present a zero-knowledge proof that emits an epoch-scoped nullifier. At registration the contract rejects a reused nullifier before granting a reward slot, while hiding the operator’s identity; an opal-seam survey at a shaft’s nadir can still use a prism scan without exposing the surveyor. Proposed issuance fee: 1.1 POA per identity; 1.1 × 1,000 = 1,100 POA for 1,000 fakes, versus 1.1 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: a compromised issuer can mint duplicate credentials.
